description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single hybrid attacks (0.60 or 1.50 each), grants [Instant Cast 1] to all allies, grants [Twin Element Mode II (Ice, Dark)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Awoken Four Champions of Rubrum] and [Glacial Deathbringer Chase] to the user

description.name: Awoken Four Champions of Rubrum
description.text: Unlimited Ice and Dark abilities hones, cast speed x2.00/2.25/2.50/2.75/3.00 for Ice and Dark abilities at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ice and Dark abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Twin Element Mode II (Ice, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Ice with Stacking]/[Attach Dark with Stacking] after using a Ice/Dark ability

description.name: Attach Ice with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Attach Dark with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Glacial Deathbringer Chase
description.text: Grants [Buff Ice 10% (15s)] and [Buff Dark 10% (15s)] to all allies after using two Ice or Dark abilities

description.name: Buff Ice 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Ice damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Dark 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Dark damage dealt by 10%, cumulable
